dustara.why: atlas: 004 left edge -> arrival (landing pad / gate)

ferrox.why: atlas: 029 left edge -> arrival (landing pad / gate)

001.name: Your House 1F
001.notes: Hero's home ground floor: Mom's kitchen table, stove, TV, stairs up, door at bottom

t: Mom: Look at you two! Remember, if your Alienmon get tired, the Recovery Bay heals them for free.
Mom: And call home once in a while, Linker.
npcs.name: Mom
pre: Mom: Good morning, sleepyhead! Dr. Vashti called. She's waiting for you at her observatory lab.
Mom: It's the big dome with the telescope, across the plaza. Go on, your partner is waiting!

002.name: Your House 2F
002.notes: Hero's bedroom: bed, desk with game console, telescope at the window, poster of the Starfall, stairs down

003.name: Vashti's Observatory Lab
003.notes: Domed lab with a big brass telescope, three capsule pedestals for the starters on a table, computers, bookshelves

objects.why: Vashti's starter pods on the lab table

t: Dr. Vashti: The Starfall Crater glows purple again. Something down there is stirring.
Dr. Vashti: Bring me news from every world you visit. And take care of your partner.
npcs.name: Dr. Vashti

t: Lab aide: Dr. Vashti tracks every seedpod that fell twenty years ago. There are still hundreds unaccounted for.
Lab aide: The big telescope points at the Starfall Crater. It's been glowing purple again.
npcs.name: Lab aide
pre: Lab aide: Dr. Vashti has been waiting for you! She's by the pod table.

004.name: Dustmere Plaza
004.notes: Home town: hero's house, Vashti's observatory dome, Recovery Bay, shop, the bridge exit east, trading post south

t: Kid: The drift grass crackles with blue sparks. That's how you know Alienmon are hiding in it!
pre: Kid: You're getting your first Alienmon today? Lucky! Dr. Vashti's lab is the dome with the telescope.

t: Old prospector: The Starfall crater glows purple every night since the pods came down.
Old prospector: Twenty years I've watched it. Something down there is still awake.
Mechanic: DX-4 keeps wandering off toward the bridge. Must be picking up a signal out there.
Linker: Press START to check your team. A tired Alienmon is a fainted Alienmon waiting to happen.
Woman: The shop dome sells Stasis Pods. You can't catch anything without them!
Woman: Weaken an Alienmon first. A full-health one just pops right back out.
Watchman: West of here is the landing pad. Ships only leave with launch clearance from a Keeper.
Nurse: Welcome to the Recovery Bay! Step up to the counter and I'll heal your team.
npcs.name: Nurse

t: Trainer: I come here after every route. Healing is free, so there's no excuse to push your luck.
Shopkeeper: Talk to me at the counter for pods and potions!
npcs.name: Shopkeeper

t: Shopper: Gels heal, Cure Spray fixes poison and burns. I always carry both.

007.name: Dustmere Bridge
007.notes: The humming canyon bridge (story: Zib's signal, M02). Long wooden-and-brass bridge over a deep canyon, glowing rune lamps

t: Hiker: Don't look down. That canyon goes all the way to the old lava falls.
Bridge keeper: This bridge was built by Ferrox steelworkers. Not a single rivet has slipped in forty years.

008.name: Trading Post
008.notes: Small outpost of stalls and a corral where Sola waits (M03 first rival battle)

t: Trader: Everything here came over the Molten Frontier on a cart. Prices reflect the danger!
Merchant: I'd sell you a map, but the Frontier changes every time the volcano coughs.
Miner: The Sunset Tunnel past the cactus gardens is the only way through to the Frontier on foot.
Drifter: Sola trains out back every morning. Tough kid. Even tougher partner.
Linker: Trainers on the trail will battle you the moment they spot you. Walk past them if you're feeling brave.

009.name: Rimwalk Trail Part A
009.notes: Canyon-rim route with drift grass, ledges you hop down, trainers

t: Hiker: The Rimwalk Trail hugs the canyon edge. Great view, terrible place to trip.
Birdwatcher: I've seen Alienmon with wings riding the thermals over the canyon.

010.name: Rimwalk Trail Part B
010.notes: Canyon-rim route with drift grass, ledges you hop down, trainers

t: Researcher: Different grass patches hold different Alienmon. Try them all!
Camper: If you're low on health, head back to Dustmere. Pride is not a healing item.

011.name: Cactus Gardens
011.notes: Maze of tall cacti and flowering succulents, drift grass, hidden items

t: Gardener: These cacti store water for months. Some Alienmon nest right inside them.
Explorer: The Sunset Tunnel is just east. Bring light, it's a maze in there.

012.name: Sunset Tunnel B1
012.notes: Sandstone tunnel to the Molten Frontier; lantern-lit, boulders

t: Miner: Watch your step. The lanterns down here run on crystal shards.

013.name: Sunset Tunnel B2
013.notes: Sandstone tunnel to the Molten Frontier; lantern-lit, boulders

t: Old miner: You can feel the heat from here. The Molten Frontier is right above us.

014.name: Molten Frontier: Tunnel Mouth
014.notes: Exit of Sunset Tunnel onto volcanic far side

t: Guard: Welcome to the Molten Frontier. Stick to the trails and stay off anything glowing.
Traveller: The ash trail east leads to Palm Isle and Port Ember. Rest up there.

015.name: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part A

t: Ash walker: The ash makes everything look grey, but the Alienmon out here are anything but dull.

016.name: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part B

t: Nomad: Magma-types love the warm ground. Hydro moves cool them off fast.
Geologist: These vents breathe every few minutes. Count to ten and you'll see.

017.name: Molten Frontier: Palm Isle
017.notes: Tropical island with Recovery Hut, palm trees, turquoise water

t: Islander: Palm Isle is the only green spot for miles. The Recovery Hut here has saved a lot of Linkers.
Fruit picker: Try the fire-coconuts. Crunchy outside, molten inside.

018.name: Molten Frontier: Port Ember
018.notes: Harbor village with the harbor Relay Gate (needs 2 Shards)

t: Sailor: The Deep Sea Ferry leaves from the long dock. Only cleared Linkers ride, though.
Dock mechanic: Helix boats have been prowling the harbor. Keep your pods close.
Fish seller: Fresh from the ember sea! Well... warm from the ember sea.
Harbor guard: Port Ember's been a safe harbor for a hundred years. We intend to keep it that way.
Linker: Every Keeper you beat gives you a Signal Shard. Eight of them and something big happens. Nobody agrees on what.

019.name: Molten Frontier: Long Dock
019.notes: Long wooden dock where the Deep Sea Ferry berths (M08 Sola's Choice scene)

t: Deckhand: Mind the gaps between the planks. The sea down there is hot enough to boil soup.

020.name: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part A

t: Climber: The Ridge Path climbs toward the Forge Gate. Helix guards everywhere up there.

021.name: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part B

t: Scout: I saw Helix grunts hauling crates toward the fortress. Something's being built in there.

022.name: Molten Frontier: Forge Gate
022.notes: Ystran Relay Gate to Ferrox, guarded by Forge Miner Dax

t: Forge worker: The Forge Gate opens toward Ferrox once you've proven yourself.
Gate guard: No clearance, no passage. Those are the rules.

023.name: Molten Frontier: Fortress Gate
023.notes: Helix Forge Fortress entrance, Helix grunt guard

t: Refugee: Helix took the old forge and turned it into a fortress. We had to leave everything.

024.name: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part A

t: Bridge tech: These lava bridges are cooled by pumps. If they stop, run.

025.name: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part B

t: Linker: Almost at the shuttle pad. Ships to the far planets launch from there.

026.name: Molten Frontier: Shuttle Pad
026.notes: Fortress Shuttle Pad to Helix Station

t: Pad controller: Shuttles leave when the board says so. The board says 'not yet'.
Helix deserter: I flew shuttles for Helix. Never again. Ask me nothing about the Director.

027.name: Molten Frontier: Shadow Tunnel Mouth
027.notes: Dark tunnel mouth leading to Umbra

t: Lantern keeper: The Shadow Tunnel leads to Umbra. The dark in there plays tricks on you.

028.name: Molten Frontier: Magma Mines Gate
028.notes: Sealed glowing-red Ystran door to Pyros

t: Mine foreman: The Magma Mines run all the way down to Pyros' crust. Hard hats mandatory.

029.name: Gate Plaza
029.notes: Arrival plaza around the Relay Gate

t: Gate guard: Welcome to Ferrox. Mind the rails, the ore carts don't stop for anyone.
Porter: Everything that lands here gets weighed, stamped and argued over. That's Ferrox for you.
Traveller: First time on Ferrox? Rustvale is just east. Best scrap stew in the system.

030.name: Rustvale
030.notes: Shanty town of shacks and converted rail cars

t: Scrapper: Everything here is built from junk. Even the Relay Tower.
Rail hand: Alloy-types love the rail yard. Bring something that burns.
Kid: Hank's Alienmon are tough as old boilers!
Watchman: Helix suits were sniffing around the crane yard last night. Hank's not happy.
Old welder: Hank Briggs runs the tower at the end of Furnace Ridge. You'll need a Shard's worth of guts to face him.
Linker: Magma moves melt Alloy-types fast. Volt moves just bounce off.
Nurse: Welcome to the Rustvale Recovery Bay. Step up to the counter!
npcs.name: Nurse

t: Miner: I patch up my Alienmon here after every shift. The nurse doesn't even charge for the soot.

objects.why: L-shaped shop counter, used from its right side

t: Shopkeeper: Pods, gels, sprays. Talk to me at the counter.
npcs.name: Shopkeeper

t: Customer: Stun Spray is a lifesaver on the Scrap Route. Those junk-types hit hard.
Grub: Mind the parts. Half of these are holding the other half together.
Grub: Come back when you've seen a bit more of Ferrox. I might have work for you.
npcs.name: Grub

t: Scavenger: The Scrap Route is all junk piles and loose rails. Alienmon love hiding in the scrap.
Hauler: My cart threw a wheel. Again. Third time this week.
Hiker: Tall rust-grass is where the wild ones hide. Walk around it if your team is tired.
Drifter: The crane yard's next. Watch for falling crates.

036.name: Crane Yard
036.notes: Swinging cranes, container stacks (Crane Yard Brawl)

t: Crane operator: Three junkers keep jamming my cranes. Hank wants them taught a lesson.
Yard guard: No Helix allowed in this yard. Not after what they pulled last month.
Junk dealer: One Linker's trash is another Linker's treasure. Mostly it's just trash.
Shopper: I came for a bolt and left with a jetpack. It doesn't work, but still.
Ore trader: Ferrox ore powers half the ships in the system. Helix wants all of it.
Fortune teller: I see... a tower. And a man with a very large wrench.
Furnace worker: The heat up here peels paint off ships. Keep your Alienmon hydrated.
Guard: Ferrox Tower is just ahead. Hank Briggs is the Keeper. Good luck, kid.
Tower engineer: Hank's apprentices train on this floor. The Keeper waits upstairs.

objects.why: Keeper's dais at the far end of the arena, challenged from (7,3)
